name: Shiori Books
description: Shiori Books is a block theme for an independent neighbourhood bookshop, set up for a shop that sells new, second-hand and rare books and holds a Saturday reading. It styles a WooCommerce catalogue and still works as a reading site when WooCommerce is not active. The front page is a day-and-evening entrance, a shelf index, a reading programme, the people of the shop, a price list and a visit panel.

summary.en: An independent bookshop: a day-and-evening split entrance, a hairline reading index with hover thumbnails, edge-flush photographs with grain panels and a dark field with a white card.

store.withoutPlugin: The shop pages list the shelves and prices as plain page text; the Cart link goes to the shop page and the store templates are not used.
